title: Test-Writer Per-Task Active Manifest v1
description: Per-task active test manifest (tests/generated/<task_id>/manifest.json). Field shapes pinned verbatim to agents/test-writer.md:90-112 (ticket 20261001-161041-r07). This is the PER-TASK active manifest, distinct from the global index file tests/generated/manifest.json (shape {kind:'index', tasks:[...]}), which this schema does NOT cover. Registered so the test-writer obligation block can name this artifact and the generic SubagentStop obligation-mode loop in hooks/subagentstop-artifact-contract-enforce.py enforces its presence/shape -- no enforcement code changed by this registration.

status.description: agents/test-writer.md:104,160 -- 'active' is the normal case; 'deferred_invalid_schema' is set when the AC's check object lacks the canonical keys for its type.

hook_check.description: Verbatim copy of the AC item's check object (agents/test-writer.md:129-130); shape varies by AC type, so this schema does not constrain its internals.
